name: search
title: ByteMail Search
description: Find mail across every shared ByteMail account. Input: search words and ByteMail operators such as from:, to:, subject:, file:.

name: draft
title: ByteMail Draft
description: Write a draft in ByteMail from the text you give. It never sends: the draft opens in ByteMail tagged Drafted by, for review and sending. Input: JSON {"to":"a@b.c","subject":"...","body":"..."} or lines 'to: a@b.c', 'subject: ...', then the body.

name: triage
title: ByteMail Inbox Triage
description: Summarize what is waiting in ByteMail: To Reply, Flagged and Snoozed, and propose what to archive or snooze. It only proposes; nothing changes until you say so.

name: unsubscribe_finder
title: ByteMail Unsubscribe Finder
description: Find newsletters with unsubscribe links across your ByteMail accounts and rank the senders. Unsubscribing always asks in ByteMail first.

name: followups
title: ByteMail Follow-ups
description: Remind you if nobody answers a ByteMail conversation you sent. Input: 'query | YYYY-MM-DD' (date optional, default three days out) or a thread_id. With a thread_id the reminder is set; otherwise matching sent conversations are listed.

name: doctor
title: ByteMail Doctor
description: Check the ByteMail app, its MCP server, account sharing and its 27 tools, and print what to fix when something is off.

name: archive
title: archive
description: Archive conversations in ByteMail. At most 25 per call: ByteMail asks the user about anything bigger, so split large batches. @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link ArchiveParams}

name: create_draft
title: create_draft
description: Write a draft in ByteMail for the user to review and send. It never sends: the draft opens in ByteMail tagged "Drafted by". To send, use bytemail/mcp_call with tool "send_draft" — ByteMail asks the user first. @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link CreateDraftParams}

name: find_attachments
title: find_attachments
description: Read-only: find files attached to mail, on this Mac and on the mail servers, newest first (wraps ByteMail's find_attachments tool). @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link FindAttachmentsParams}

name: find_contacts
title: find_contacts
description: Read-only: people in the shared ByteMail accounts' mail whose name or address matches, most-written-to first. Turns a name into an address. @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link FindContactsParams}

name: get_thread
title: get_thread
description: Read-only: every message of one ByteMail conversation, oldest first, quoted history removed (wraps ByteMail's get_thread tool). @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link GetThreadParams}

name: list_threads
title: list_threads
description: Read-only: conversations in a ByteMail mailbox, newest first (wraps ByteMail's list_threads tool). @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link ListThreadsParams}

name: mcp_call
title: mcp_call
description: Run any live ByteMail MCP tool by name — tools/call only, never raw RPC; the name must match ByteMail's own tools/list. ByteMail's in-app approvals still apply: send, rules, label removal, unsubscribe and block ask the user first. @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link McpCallParams}

name: search_messages
title: search_messages
description: Read-only: find messages across every shared ByteMail account, wrapping ByteMail's search_messages tool. All given filters must match. @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link SearchParams}

name: snooze
title: snooze
description: Snooze conversations in ByteMail until a moment, when they come back to the inbox as new. At most 25 per call. @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link SnoozeParams}

name: status
title: status
description: Read-only health check: is ByteMail installed, is its MCP server answering, is mail being shared, and which tools and accounts are live. Body is {@link StatusParams}. @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link StatusParams}
